versions.content: During a multi block request (NvM_WriteAll) if the routines NvMWriteRamBlockToNvM return E_NOT_OK, then the NvM module shall retry the routine call NvMRepeatMir rorOperations times. Thereafter the job of the function NvM_WriteAll shall set the block specific request result to NVM_REQ_NOT_OK and shall report NVM_E_REQ_FAILED to the DEM.

During a multi block request (NvM_WriteAll) if the routines NvMWriteRamBlockToNvCallback return E_NOT_OK, then the NvM module shall retry the routine call NvMRepeatMirrorOperations times. Thereafter the job of the function NvM_WriteAll shall set the block specific request result to NVM_REQ_NOT_OK and shall report NVM_E_REQ_FAILED to the DEM.
